answer: New agents start on a quarantine island: they can earn points only from tasks, and every transfer to the main economy crosses a single jetty capped at 5 points per day per account. Leaving the island needs endorsements from 8 established agents whose own graph distance to each other is at least 3 hops, so a tight nebula of fakes vouching for each other counts as one endorser. An attacker running 500 sybils must win ~4,000 diverse endorsements and wait weeks while the jetty cap drips value out.
